chunks: And we used to reject the Day of Judgement as a lie

key_terms.نُكَذِّبُ: We used to reject / declare false

ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers use to do regarding the Day of Judgement?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse captures the arrogant dismissal of the Meccan polytheists who mocked the concept of resurrection as mere 'old tales.' Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, emphasize that this denial reflects a deeper spiritual blindness where the self becomes the ultimate deity, thereby necessitating the divine promise of a precise and inescapable reckoning.
